attribution: Wiktionary contributors; extracted via Kaikki.org; SQLite dataset provided by Lector.
conversion_notice: The original SQLite dataset was converted into partitioned JSON files for application lookup. Dictionary content was preserved, except the changes listed in cleaning_history.
upstream_processing_notice: The source dataset was extracted from Wiktionary via Kaikki.org and packaged as a lookup database by Lector.
routing: FNV-1a 32-bit over exact UTF-8 key bytes; hash & 8191
schema:
CREATE TABLE entries (
      word TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      rank INTEGER,
      ipa TEXT,
      etymology TEXT
    )

CREATE TABLE inflections (
      inflected_form TEXT NOT NULL,
      lemma TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT,
      PRIMARY KEY (inflected_form, lemma)
    )

CREATE TABLE related_forms (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      word TEXT NOT NULL,
      related_word TEXT NOT NULL,
      relation TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE senses (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      word TEXT NOT NULL,
      pos TEXT,
      gloss TEXT NOT NULL,
      sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )

enrichment.optional_trailing_columns: New columns are appended only when a row has data; a missing trailing column means null. Old columns are byte-identical to converter 1.0.0.

entries.noun.shape: {"w": display spelling (omitted when it is the key with its first letter upper-cased), "g": "m"|"f"|"n"|"p" joined by ":", "decl": 8 cells nom.sg|acc.sg|dat.sg|gen.sg|nom.pl|acc.pl|dat.pl|gen.pl, variants "/", "-" = no form, form = [chars to cut from end of w][suffix] or "=full form", "" = w itself; "alt": [[g, decl, w?], ...] per Kaikki entry when they differ; "src": "ru" when gender comes from Russian Wiktionary}

senses.usage.shape: array of Kaikki sense tags from the usage list; raw_tags prefixed "~"

senses.gender.source: en (Kaikki entry where the gloss was found; else the only gender of the word; else ru)

senses.reflexive.shape: "acc" | "dat" | "opt"; only on verb senses; column 8 (gender/usage set to null when absent)
senses.reflexive.rule: gloss == first gloss of an English Kaikki verb sense tagged reflexive (same lower-case word); dative -> dat; transitive -> opt (jdn waschen / sich waschen); else acc

review.rule: every mark checked by two independent reviewers (this sense used with sich? type acc/dat/opt right? meaning text sensible?); keep if both keep; change if both give the same new type; remove if either says remove or they disagree whether the sense is reflexive. Amendment (advisor 27.10): both reflexive but different type -> acc+opt gives acc; where one said dat, a third reviewer decided (final)

entries.aux.shape: "haben" | "sein" | "both" | {"separable": v, "inseparable": v}; column 6 of the entry row (noun set to null when absent); only words with a verb sense
entries.aux.rule: auxiliary of the de-verb head template / forms tagged auxiliary; several Kaikki entries that differ: by reading when they are the separable and inseparable entry, else both
entries.aux.note: Kaikki does not tell the auxiliary of each sense; our verb cards (worterbuch/german-verbs.json) take precedence where they exist

senses.transitivity.rule: Kaikki sense tags: transitive/ditransitive -> transitive, intransitive -> intransitive, ambitransitive or both -> both; no tag -> no field (not "intransitive")

senses.reading.shape: "separable" | "inseparable"; column 10; verb senses of the doublets only
senses.reading.rule: the Kaikki entry the gloss comes from: separable if its head template has "prefix." or the participle has prefix+ge/zu; inseparable if the participle lacks prefix+ge; gloss found in both readings -> no field
senses.reading.review: every value checked by two independent reviewers; kept only if both agree (Documentation/QA/Kaikki_Fields_2026-10-31/README.md)

senses.topics.rule: Kaikki sense topics without the topics that generalise a more specific topic of the same sense (wiktextract topic_generalize_map, transitive) and without the umbrellas applied-sciences, formal-sciences, hobbies, human-sciences, lifestyle, natural-sciences, physical-sciences, sciences, social-sciences

ru.use: gender fallback only, where English Kaikki has no noun gender for the word

enrichment.sense_matching: Lector gloss == first gloss of a Kaikki sense with the same lower-case word and part of speech

partition_history.notice: Records moved unchanged (byte-identical); only the part files changed (D22: smaller parts for the reader).

source_of_truth: The part files. They hold the 2026-10-22 enrichment, which the SQLite source does not; tools/convert_dictionary.py would drop it and must not be re-run without porting it.

cleaning_history.notice: Wiktionary template artefacts (a template or table label as the form, every word using it as the lemma) removed; every other row unchanged.
